facts.text: I built a Python pipeline that takes source content and content ideas, runs them through extraction, drafting, voice/rubric evaluation, claims checking, novelty evaluation, trust-gating and calendar rendering, and produces validated, scored posts that are either cleared for publishing or flagged for human review, across three MongoDB Atlas collections.
I wrote a FastAPI intake service with Pydantic contracts on the inputs.

Between the model stages I wrote deterministic validation that checks schema and contract conformance and whether the output satisfies the trust conditions, including blocking voice findings, unsupported evidence and sensitive claims.

I noticed the scoring looked wrong because a duplicated judgment path was influencing the rubric result. I ran a controlled probe holding the content and surrounding conditions constant, and the decision moved from 11/15 ship to 10/15 rewrite when the duplicated judgment was exposed. I corrected the scoring specification before the pattern spread into six further implementations.

facts.text: I provided technical leadership for 3 developers, including sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, design discussions, and Azure DevOps pull-request reviews.
I introduced GitHub Copilot into the team's .NET development workflow and used it across implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.

I set the review and security rules for AI-generated code: no credentials or environment configuration in external tools, and AI-assisted changes had to pass the same PR review, automated testing, and release gates as normal code.
I continued working across .NET and Angular application delivery while collaborating with product owners, QA, and business stakeholders on requirements and technical decisions.

facts.text: I built and maintained C#/.NET backend services, REST APIs, and Angular front ends for multi-tenant enterprise applications.
I worked on SQL Server data access and performance, including queries, indexes, stored procedures, execution plans, and changes to the .NET data-access path.
I built application-side integrations across multiple source systems and wrote Python ingestion for live tracking data that published events through Apache Kafka.
I built Elasticsearch-based retrieval for historical tracking data.
I implemented tenant-scoped data access and organisation-level filtering, and built D3.js dashboards and data visualizations for the application.
I handled production troubleshooting with New Relic and traced issues across the frontend, API, business-logic, database, and deployment layers.
